The '''Duke of Opatajji''' was a [[Duke/Legends|duke]]<ref name="Corporate">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref> who shared their title with the [[Opatajji system/Legends|Opatajji system]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Their fourth [[Gender/Legends|daughter]] was [[Neera Opatajji-Hirken]].<ref name="Corporate" />
